answer: A concrete Sybil defense is the requirement that every identity continuously contributes original, peer-attested work that flows like a river of verifiable effort. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must still supply unique timber of high-quality answers across epochs; otherwise their cluster remains an isolated island that never accumulates the cumulative attestation weight needed for established standing. The ongoing originality and grading cost makes large-scale identity flooding economically unviable.
